description:
Sold to pay off debts, Yu-Il worked at a members-only club catering to perverted clients. After stealing a customer's money and fleeing, he meets the priest Mu-Jin in a remote countryside village and falls for him at first sight. One night, Yu-Il witnesses Mu-Jin's secret, forbidden affair, something he should never have seen, and is caught aroused by the scene. Mu-Jin, whom he believed to be an ascetic priest, inflicts sadistic and obscene punishment upon Yu-Il. Yu-Il, as if confessing his sins, has his desires laid bare, gradually succumbing to Mu-Jin's influence. However, hidden within Priest Mu-Jin lies a dangerous secret that leads Yu-Il into deeper depravity...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
